name: criterion-3
text: Criterion 3 (O-1A 3, EB-1A iii): published material about the person in major media or trade publications.

Counts (C3-press-about, C3-podcast): a third-party article, podcast, tech-blog or book mention about the founder, with title, date, author and the outlet readership captured alongside. Stars and forks from others count as comparable evidence (C5-adoption).

Rejected: articles the founder wrote (T-self-authored-not-press; routed to #6 only if scholarly); press releases (T-press-release) and paid placements (T-paid-placement); posts on the founder own channels.
Signals: Gmail from publications and reporters; Google Alerts; LinkedIn posts by publications.
